purpose: Built-in closest-number tie-breakers. Closest numeric answer wins; exact distance ties can fall back to fastest authoritative submission time.
researchPolicy: Prefer fixed or historically anchored numerical facts.
Prefer first-party, governing-body or authoritative reference sources.
Avoid live populations, prices, rankings and records that can drift unless explicitly date-stamped.
Film runtime questions use the BBFC page's approximate running-minutes figure to avoid mixing cuts.
Music duration questions identify a published track/version where version differences could matter.
